title: 咖啡制作跟读 + 理财面试

task1.en: Make a shot of espresso using the machine.
task1.zh: 用机器做一份浓缩咖啡。
task1.err: Make a shot of pretzel using the machine.

task1.en: Steam the milk until it is hot and bubbling.
chunks: until it is hot and bubbling

task1.en: Pour the espresso into an appropriately sized cup.
task1.zh: 把浓缩咖啡倒进大小合适的杯子里。

task1.en: Ask the customer if they want sugar or honey before adding anything.

task1.zh: 上桌前，在杯旁的杯托上放一小块巧克力。

task2.q: Do you make financial plans for your future? Why or why not?
task2.my: Well, yes, I do make a financial plan for my future. I have two main reasons for this. The first one is that it can protect my future financial stability and I can save more money for my future because I want to go to study abroad and go travel. I should plan ahead. The second, I make the plan to teach me how to get more money.

model2.en: yes, I do make a financial plan for my future.
it protects my future financial stability.
I want to study abroad and travel one day.
I hope to do a master's in business at a school like NYU.
I save a little money every month for that dream.
making a plan teaches me how to manage money.
I learn to budget and spend less.
I use an app to track what I spend each week.
I know exactly where my money goes.
I always plan my money carefully.

task2.q: How do people usually manage their money in daily life?
task2.my: Well, I think usually have two main strategies to manage money. The first one is uh, use the app about uh, the financial control, uh, such as the app of uh, calculating the outgo and uh, and others. Uh, the second way is uh, reserving the uh, bank and consult the professional people to teach you.

model2.en: people usually manage money in two main ways.
they use apps to control their spending.
these apps record every cost clearly.
many people track meals, transport, and shopping on an app.
they can see their outgo and cut waste.
they ask banks or professionals for advice.
experts give them a safer plan.
they meet a bank advisor once a month.
they learn to save and invest better.
apps and experts are two common ways.

task2.q: Do you think money influences people's decisions? Why?
task2.my: Well, I think money do influence people's decisions. Uh, I have to make reason one. Uh, money is very useful. With money you can buy a lot of things. Uh, you can do a lot of things. Uh, such, for example, uh, if you want to go travel and you want to learn something skill, and you should use money to buy some courses and others. And uh, second, the money, it can afford your life, uh, such as uh, eating.

task2.q: Should schools teach financial management skills? Why or why not?
task2.my: Well, I think school should teach financial courses. It's very useful, especially for college students, to learn to manage their money. Such as, if they can learn how to get more financial plans with their money, they can be more independent in their life and afterwards studies. And second, college is a very good time to learn this. Before you have money, you should know how to plan it.

it helps students become independent.
they learn to plan and control their own money.
a college student learns to budget rent and food.
they depend less on parents and handle life better.
college is the perfect time to learn this.

they manage part-time pay or a scholarship.

schools should teach these useful skills.
